scripts.test:summary: bash -lc 'TEST_LOG=/tmp/planner-full-test-run.tap; npx tsx --test --test-reporter=tap $(find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -name "*.test.ts" -print) > "$TEST_LOG"; TEST_EXIT=$?; echo ""; echo "===== TEST SUMMARY ====="; grep -E "^# (tests|suites|pass|fail|cancelled|skipped|todo|duration_ms)" "$TEST_LOG"; echo ""; echo "Full log saved to: $TEST_LOG"; exit $TEST_EXIT'
